events.title: v0.3.7 Update - Shooting Star Buffs, Major Difficulty Overhaul
events.summary: A new demo update. This time we focused on rebalancing so that the game never feels unreasonably harsh. Thank you for playing, and sharing your thoughts helps our development a lot!NewShooting stars now fall during battle preparation. events.title: v0.3.3 Minor Patch
events.summary: Fixed a bug where destroying a structure during Bonus Time didn't play its destruction sequence or grant rewards.Optimization pass: reduced in-combat stutters and improved save reliability.Adjusted some Trinket effects and clarified their descriptions.

events.title: v0.3.0 Update — Trinket System & Star Currency
events.summary: This is a major update to the Little Critter Hunters demo. Two new collectible features have been added: Trinkets and the Star currency. Equip a trinket on each hero to optimize your build! Gather shooting stars to make your trinkets even stronger.Trinket System (New)A suspicious parrot carrying a trinket occasionally crashes into battle. Catch it before it escapes and it drops a trinket!7 trinkets are available in the demo. Each hero can equip one for a unique effect.Bonus Time — Star Currency

events.title: Demo is Out & v0.2.1 Update — UI Improvements, Discord Server
events.summary: The Little Critter Hunters demo is now playable on Steam and itch.io. We'll keep improving the game after the demo launch, and honest feedback from players means a lot to us. If you enjoyed the game, please add it to your wishlist! Thank you for playing! v0.2.1 — UI Improvements Polished the UI frames and smoothed out the overall look and feel.Bug Fixes Fixed the cursor disappearing in fullscreen on the web version Fixed leftover projectiles and status effects lingering after battle end Discord
